# Dreel — Hospital Review Platform: Backend

# Dreel — Hospital Review Platform: Backend

Express 5 API for the Hospital Review Platform (Nigeria first). Authentication is handled by Supabase Auth, data lives in Supabase Postgres, and the app talks to the database through Prisma 6.12.0, which uses its own database engine (there is no `pg` driver adapter and no `pg` package in the app).

> **Keep this README up to date.** Every time a file is added, changed or removed, update this file and the change log at the bottom in the same step.

---

## 1. How this code got here (read this first)

* **Original files** (marked *original* below) came from the backend zip uploaded on 2026-11-21. They were built before the hardening work started.
* **Files marked *added* or *updated*** were created or changed during the hardening work (the database SSL fix and roadmap tasks 1-6b).
* No code has been edited by hand: every change was applied exactly as supplied, so this README describes the current state of the project.
* The files marked *added* or *updated* are what has been **delivered**. Use the install checklist in section 8 to tick off what has been applied, and correct this README if any delivered file has not been applied yet.

### `controllers/`


| File                               | Origin                         | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `auth.controller.js`               | original, updated (tasks 1–4) | The auth handlers:`register`,`login`,`logout`,`getMe`,`forgotPassword`,`resendConfirmation`. Supabase creates and signs in accounts; Prisma reads and updates the`users`table. Errors are thrown and handled centrally. Registration returns the same 201 response for new and already-registered emails (account-enumeration protection) and builds its response from the signup result with no database read. Audit events are written fire-and-forget.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `user.controller.js`               | added (task 5)                 | Profile and notification-preference handlers for the signed-in user only:`getProfile`,`updateProfile`(a taken username returns 409`USERNAME_TAKEN`),`getNotificationPreferences`(creates the default row on first use) and`updateNotificationPreferences`. No user ID appears in any URL, so one user can never reach another's data. Audit events store field names, never values.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `hospital.controller.js`           | added (tasks 6a, 6b)           | Public hospital directory:`listHospitals`(text search, filters, sorting, pagination and near-me search),`getHospital`and`getHospitalFilters`. Search text is matched word by word against name, city, LGA and state with`%`,`_`and`\`treated literally. If that finds nothing, a typo-tolerant search runs (`src/services/hospitalSearch.js`) and the response says`search.matchType: "close"`. Near-me search lets the database discard everything outside a bounding box, then works out exact distances (haversine) for the rest. Detail pages add`contact`(with`socialMedia`for claimed hospitals),`services`and`info`, built from`hospital_data`by`src/utils/hospitalDetails.js`; the raw column is never sent. Responses follow the approved shape described in section 5 ("Hospital response shape"). The public only sees three verification states (`verified`,`claimed`,`unclaimed`); the seven internal workflow values are mapped in`PUBLIC_VERIFICATION_STATUS`, so a rejected claim or a suspension is never shown. Every hospital carries its`rating`(average and count of published reviews), and`sort=rating`ranks by a damped score so one 5-star review does not beat a well-reviewed hospital. |
| `location.controller.js`           | added (task 6a)                | `listStates`and`listLgas`: reference data for the search filters, with hospital counts, cacheable for an hour.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `review.controller.js`             | added (task 6b)                | Reviews. Public:`listHospitalReviews`and`getRatingSummary`(average, star distribution, category averages). Signed-in authors:`createReview`(one per hospital per user, email must be confirmed, held for moderation unless`REVIEWS_REQUIRE_MODERATION=false`),`updateReview`(editing the wording, ratings or department sends it back to moderation),`deleteReview`and`getMyReviews`. Anonymous reviews, and reviews of deleted accounts, show the author as "Anonymous".                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `moderation.controller.js`         | added (task 6b)                | For moderators and admins:`listReviewQueue`(oldest first),`approveReview`and`rejectReview`(a reason is required; it also takes down a published review). Each action is one atomic database step, so two moderators acting at once cannot both succeed, and nobody can moderate their own review.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `claim.controller.js`              | added (task 6c)                | For signed-in users:`createClaim`(needs a confirmed email; up to 3 claims waiting at once; the hospital becomes`claim_pending`),`withdrawClaim`,`getMyClaims`,`getMyHospitals`(the hospitals you represent, with their real status),`createVerification`(representatives of a`claimed`hospital) and`updateSocialMedia`(representatives; add, change or remove links). Every change that touches claims or status runs in one transaction that locks the hospital row first, so simultaneous actions queue up instead of deadlocking.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `claimModeration.controller.js`    | added (task 6c)                | For moderators and admins: the claim queue with`approveClaim`(the claimant becomes a representative, the hospital becomes`claimed`, other waiting claims are closed) and`rejectClaim`; the verification queue with`approveVerification`and`rejectVerification`; and, for admins only,`suspendHospital`and`unsuspendHospital`. Nobody can review their own claim or request. Queues show the person's email so they can be contacted.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `document.controller.js`           | added (task 6c)                | Proof documents.`requestClaimDocumentUpload`/`requestVerificationDocumentUpload`record a file and return a one-use upload link;`confirmDocument`checks the real uploaded file (size and first bytes) and deletes it if it is not what it claimed to be;`deleteDocument`lets the owner remove a file while the submission is waiting;`getDocumentViewUrl`gives moderators a 5-minute link after writing the audit record (no record, no link).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `notification.controller.js`       | added                          | A person's own in-app notifications: list (with unread count and`?unread=true`), unread count, mark one or all as read, delete. Somebody else's notification looks like one that does not exist.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `report.controller.js`             | added (task 6d)                | `createReport`: a signed-in person (or a hospital representative) reports a published review. Never hides the review.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `reportModeration.controller.js`   | added (task 6d)                | The report queue (one entry per review) and the decisions:`investigateReports`,`escalateReports`(admin-only afterwards),`dismissReports`,`upholdReports`(takes the review down). Each decision runs in one transaction that locks the review, so two moderators cannot both decide.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `response.controller.js`           | added (task 6d)                | A hospital representative's public reply to a review:`saveResponse`(create or replace),`deleteResponse`and`listHospitalResponses`(the dashboard). Goes to moderation unless`RESPONSES_REQUIRE_MODERATION=false`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `responseModeration.controller.js` | added (task 6d)                | The queue of responses waiting for a moderator, with the review each one answers, plus`approveResponse`and`rejectResponse`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `moderationHistory.controller.js`  | added (task 6d)                | Read-only`GET /moderation/history`with filters.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `admin.controller.js`              | added (task 7)                 | Account management for administrators:`listUsers`,`getUser`,`changeRole`,`suspendUser`,`reactivateUser`. Every change locks the admin rows first and checks the person acting is still an admin, so the last administrator cannot be removed even by two simultaneous requests.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `hospitalControllers.js`           | original                       | Empty placeholder, now superseded by`hospital.controller.js`.**Delete it.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

| -------------------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `purge-documents.js` | added (task 6c) | Retention job:`npm run purge:documents`. Deletes from private storage every proof document whose retention time has passed (30 days after its claim or request was decided) and every upload nobody confirmed within 24 hours. Rows stay, marked`purged`. Safe to run twice. Run it daily from a cron job, a scheduled GitHub Action, or by hand. |
| `send-emails.js`     | added           | `npm run send:emails`: sends the queued emails once and exits. The server already does this every 30 seconds; use this from a scheduler if your host puts the server to sleep.                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `send-test-email.js` | added           | `npm run test:email -- you@example.com`: checks your SMTP host, port and login, then sends one test message, with plain-language hints for the usual mistakes (wrong password, unreachable server, unverified From address). Never prints the password.                                                                                           |
| `make-admin.js`      | added (task 7)  | `npm run make:admin -- you@example.com`: makes the first administrator without SQL. Refuses once an active administrator exists unless`--force`. Needs a confirmed, active account.                                                                                                                                                               |

### `src/middleware/`


| File                 | Origin                         | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `auth.middleware.js` | original, updated (tasks 3–4) | `authenticate`: checks the Bearer token (shape check first, then Supabase`getUser`), loads the user from the database, rejects deactivated accounts, sets`req.user`and`req.accessToken`.`authorize(...roles)`: role check for later routes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `rateLimiter.js`     | added (tasks 1, 3, 6)          | Rate limiters: general API, register, login (failed attempts only, per IP and per IP + email), forgot-password and resend-confirmation (per IP and per target email), and`sensitiveLimiter`for signed-in users (30 per 15 minutes per user; used on the profile and notification update routes),`searchLimiter`(60 hospital searches per minute per IP),`reviewCreateLimiter`(5 new reviews per user per day) and`moderationLimiter`(300 actions per 15 minutes per moderator). 429 responses include`code`and`requestId`. In-memory store: resets on restart and covers one server only. |
| `validate.js`        | added (tasks 2, 3)             | `validate({ body, params, query })`runs Zod schemas, replaces`req.body`/`req.params`with the cleaned data (parsed query is`req.validatedQuery`) and forwards failures as a`ValidationError`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `errorHandler.js`    | added (task 3)                 | `notFoundHandler`(404) and`errorHandler`. Maps Prisma errors (connection failures become 503 with`Retry-After`), Supabase auth errors, Zod errors, bad or oversized JSON and unknown errors to a safe JSON shape. Logs server errors with the request ID. Hides internals in production; adds a`debug`field in development.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `requestId.js`       | added (tasks 3, 4)             | Gives each request an ID (`req.id`,`X-Request-Id`header) and stores the ID, client IP and user agent in the request context for audit logging.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `security.js`        | added (task 4)                 | `securityHeaders`(Helmet; the`/api-docs`pages skip only the CSP so Swagger UI works) and`noStore`(no caching of auth responses).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

The whole router is behind`authenticate`,`authorize("MODERATOR", "ADMIN")`and`moderationLimiter`; the role is read from the database on every request.                                      |
| `claimRoutes.js`        | added (task 6c)                | Mounted at`/api`:`POST /hospitals/:id/claims`,`POST /claims/:id/withdraw`,`POST /hospitals/:id/verification` `PATCH /hospitals/:id/social-media`,`GET /hospitals/:id/verification`,`POST /claims/:id/documents`,`POST /verifications/:id/documents`,`POST /documents/:id/confirm`and`DELETE /documents/:id`.`authenticate`is applied route by route so unknown URLs still answer 404. |
| `notificationRoutes.js` | added                          | Mounted at`/api/notifications`:`GET /`,`GET /unread-count`,`POST /read-all`,`POST /:id/read`,`DELETE /:id`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `responseRoutes.js`     | added (task 6d)                | Mounted at`/api`:`POST /reviews/:id/reports`,`PUT`and`DELETE /reviews/:id/response`,`GET /hospitals/:id/responses`.`authenticate`is applied route by route so unknown URLs still answer 404.                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `adminRoutes.js`        | added (task 7)                 | Mounted at`/api/admin`: users list and detail, role change, suspend, reactivate. Admins only; moderators get 403.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

| `audit.service.js`             | added (task 4)  | `recordSecurityEvent(userId, eventType, metadata)`writes to`security_events`(adds request ID, IP and user agent automatically);`recordLogin(...)`writes to`login_activities`;`hashEmail(email)`makes the short hash stored instead of an address. They never throw; call them with`void`so they don't delay the response.                                                                                                                             |
| `hospitalAccess.js`            | added (task 6c) | Who may act for a hospital and what state it is in:`requireRepresentative`,`assertNoConflictOfInterest`(representatives and pending claimants cannot review that hospital),`lockHospital`(locks the hospital row; every claim or status transaction calls it first),`deriveStatus`(works a hospital's status out again after a suspension) and the`OPEN_FOR_CLAIMS`/`HAS_REPRESENTATIVE`status lists.                                                 |
| `hospitalSearch.js`            | added (task 6c) | Typo-tolerant search using the PostgreSQL`pg_trgm`extension. Words of 3 letters or fewer must match exactly; 4-5 letter words need a close match (0.6 or higher), longer words a looser one (0.4 or higher). Every search word must match the name, city, LGA or state; results are ranked by closeness. If the extension is missing it logs a hint and returns nothing, so exact search keeps working. All tuning values are at the top of the file. |
| `documentStorage.service.js`   | added (task 6c) | The only code that talks to Supabase Storage:`createUploadTarget`(one-use upload link),`inspectObject`(real size and file type from the first bytes),`createViewUrl`(short-lived read link) and`removeObjects`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `notification.service.js`      | added           | `notify(userId, type, values, data)`and`notifyMany`. Checks the person's settings, then writes the in-app notification and the queued email together. Never throws, so a notification problem cannot undo a moderator's decision.                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `emailTemplates.js`            | added           | The wording of every notification, as an in-app message AND an email (plain text and HTML). All text that came from a person is escaped; subjects are forced onto one line. Button paths (`PATHS`) are at the top: change them to match your frontend's routes.                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `mailWorker.js`                | added           | Sends the queue. See "Notifications and email". All timings (check every 30 seconds, retries, 72-hour expiry, cleanup) are named values at the top of the file.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `moderationHistory.service.js` | added (task 6d) | `recordModerationAction(tx, actor, entry)`: writes one row of the moderation history. Always called inside the same transaction as the action it records.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `authAdmin.service.js`         | added (task 7)  | Best-effort call to Supabase that stops (or resumes) issuing tokens to a suspended person. Needs`SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`; the suspension stands even if it fails.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

---

## 5. API endpoints


| Method and path                                        | Auth                    | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `GET /`                                                | none                    | Basic status message.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `GET /api-docs`                                        | none                    | Swagger UI (production: only with`ENABLE_API_DOCS=true`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `GET /api/hospitals`                                   | none                    | Search and list. Parameters:`q`,`stateId`,`lgaId`,`typeId`,`ownership`(`federal`/`state`/`private`),`lat`+`lng`(+`radiusKm`, default 25),`sort`(`name`,`newest`,`rating`,`distance`,`relevance`),`page`,`limit`. Every hospital includes`rating`(average and count of published reviews). With`lat`and`lng`results are nearest first and include`distanceKm`. 60 searches per minute per IP.**Typos:**if the exact search finds nothing, close matches are returned instead ("hosptial lagoss" finds Lagos hospitals) and the response carries`search.matchType`(`exact`or`close`) so the frontend can say "Showing close matches". Close matches default to`sort=relevance`(best first). |
| `GET /api/hospitals/filters`                           | none                    | Hospital types, and the three ownership values with labels and counts (all three always listed), for the search filters. Cacheable for an hour.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `GET /api/hospitals/:id`                               | none                    | One hospital in the full approved shape:`location`,`contact`,`services`,`info`,`status`and`rating`, plus type, ownership, description, year established and accessibility information.`contact`,`services`and`info`are always present, with`null`or`[]`where nothing valid exists. 404`HOSPITAL_NOT_FOUND`if unknown.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `GET /api/states`                                      | none                    | All states with hospital counts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `GET /api/states/:stateId/lgas`                        | none                    | The LGAs of a state with hospital counts. 404`STATE_NOT_FOUND`if unknown.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `GET /api/hospitals/:id/reviews`                       | none                    | Published reviews, 10 per page by default.`sort`:`newest`(default),`oldest`,`highest`,`lowest`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `GET /api/hospitals/:id/rating-summary`                | none                    | Average rating, review count, how many reviews gave each star rating, and the average per category.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `POST /api/hospitals/:id/reviews`                      | Bearer                  | Write a review. Needs a confirmed email. One per hospital per user (409`REVIEW_ALREADY_EXISTS`), 5 new reviews per user per day. Returns the review with its status.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `PATCH /api/reviews/:id`                               | Bearer                  | Edit your own review (404 for anyone else's). Changing the wording, ratings or department sends it back to moderation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `DELETE /api/reviews/:id`                              | Bearer                  | Delete your own review. You can then write a new one.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `GET /api/users/me/reviews`                            | Bearer                  | Your own reviews in every status, with the moderator's reason for rejected ones. Filter with`status`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `GET /api/moderation/reviews`                          | Moderator or admin      | The queue (`status`, default`pending_moderation`), oldest first. Shows each author's id and name, never an email.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `POST /api/moderation/reviews/:id/approve`             | Moderator or admin      | Publish a pending or rejected review (409 if already moderated; 403 for your own).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `POST /api/moderation/reviews/:id/reject`              | Moderator or admin      | Body`{ "reason": "…" }`. Rejects a pending review or takes down a published one.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `POST /api/hospitals/:id/claims`                       | Bearer                  | Claim a hospital. Body:`{ jobTitle, officialEmail?, officialPhone?, message? }`. Needs a confirmed email. 409 if the hospital is claimed, suspended, you already have a claim there, or you have 3 waiting. 5 per day.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `POST /api/claims/:id/withdraw`                        | Bearer                  | Withdraw your own claim that is still waiting. Empty body.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `GET /api/users/me/claims`                             | Bearer                  | Your claims with status and, if rejected, the reason.`?status=`,`page`,`limit`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `GET /api/users/me/hospitals`                          | Bearer                  | Hospitals you represent, with their real status (including`suspended`) and social links.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `POST /api/hospitals/:id/verification`                 | Bearer (representative) | Ask for the verified badge. Body:`{ registrationBody, registrationNumber, officialEmail?, message? }`. The hospital must be`claimed`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `GET /api/hospitals/:id/verification`                  | Bearer (representative) | Your hospital's last 5 verification requests with status, the moderator's note if rejected, and attached documents.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `POST /api/claims/:id/documents`                       | Bearer (claimant)       | Step 1 of an upload. Body:`{ documentType, fileName, mimeType, sizeBytes }`. Returns the document and a one-use upload link. Only while the claim is waiting; at most 5 documents.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `POST /api/verifications/:id/documents`                | Bearer (requester)      | The same, for a verification request.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `POST /api/documents/:id/confirm`                      | Bearer (owner)          | Step 3: the server checks the real file. 409`UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND`if it has not arrived; 422`UPLOAD_INVALID`(and the file is deleted) if it is empty, over 5 MB, or not a genuine file of the declared type.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `DELETE /api/documents/:id`                            | Bearer (owner)          | Remove one of your documents while the submission is waiting.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `PATCH /api/hospitals/:id/social-media`                | Bearer (representative) | Body: any of`facebook`,`instagram`,`x`,`linkedin`,`youtube`,`tiktok`; a value of`null`removes that link. Not allowed while suspended.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `GET /api/moderation/claims`                           | Moderator or admin      | Claim queue, oldest first, with the claimant's email.`?status=pending`(default),`approved`,`rejected`,`withdrawn`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `POST /api/moderation/claims/:id/approve`              | Moderator or admin      | Claimant becomes the representative; hospital becomes`claimed`; other waiting claims for it are closed. Not your own claim.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `POST /api/moderation/claims/:id/reject`               | Moderator or admin      | Body`{ "reason": "…" }`; the claimant can read it. If it was the last waiting claim the hospital becomes`rejected`(claimable again).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `GET /api/moderation/verifications`                    | Moderator or admin      | Verification requests, oldest first.`?status=pending`(default),`approved`,`rejected`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `POST /api/moderation/verifications/:id/approve`       | Moderator or admin      | Hospital becomes`verified`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `POST /api/moderation/verifications/:id/reject`        | Moderator or admin      | Body`{ "reason": "…" }`. Hospital goes back to`claimed`; the representative can submit again.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `GET /api/moderation/documents/:id/url`                | Moderator or admin      | A 5-minute link to open the file. The view is written to the audit log first; if that fails, no link is given.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `GET /api/notifications`                               | Bearer                  | Your notifications, newest first, each with`read`and`data`(ids for linking, such as`claimId`and`hospitalId`). Also returns`unreadCount`.`?unread=true`,`page`,`limit`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `GET /api/notifications/unread-count`                  | Bearer                  | Just the number, for the badge.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `POST /api/notifications/:id/read`                     | Bearer                  | Mark one as read (doing it twice is fine). 404 for somebody else's.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `POST /api/notifications/read-all`                     | Bearer                  | Mark all as read.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `DELETE /api/notifications/:id`                        | Bearer                  | Delete one.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `POST /api/reviews/:id/reports`                        | Bearer                  | Report a published review. Body:`{ reason, details? }`. 409`ALREADY_REPORTED`; 403 for your own review; 10 per day.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `PUT /api/reviews/:id/response`                        | Bearer (representative) | Body:`{ body }`(10 to 1500 characters, no links). Creates (201) or replaces (200) your hospital's response; it waits for a moderator before it shows.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `DELETE /api/reviews/:id/response`                     | Bearer (representative) | Remove your hospital's response.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `GET /api/hospitals/:id/responses`                     | Bearer (representative) | The hospital's published reviews with the response state of each.`?unanswered=true`,`page`,`limit`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `GET /api/moderation/reports`                          | Moderator or admin      | Reported reviews, one entry each, escalated first then oldest first.`?status=`,`?escalated=true`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `POST /api/moderation/reviews/:id/reports/investigate` | Moderator or admin      | Body`{ note? }`. Review stays published.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `POST /api/moderation/reviews/:id/reports/escalate`    | Moderator or admin      | Body`{ note }`(required). Only an admin can decide afterwards.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `POST /api/moderation/reviews/:id/reports/dismiss`     | Moderator or admin      | Body`{ note? }`. Review stays; reporters are told. Admin only if escalated.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `POST /api/moderation/reviews/:id/reports/uphold`      | Moderator or admin      | Body`{ reason }`. Takes the review down; author and reporters are told. Admin only if escalated.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `GET /api/moderation/responses`                        | Moderator or admin      | Responses waiting for review, oldest first, each with the review it answers.`?status=pending_moderation`(default),`published`,`rejected`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `POST /api/moderation/responses/:id/approve`           | Moderator or admin      | Publishes the response.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `POST /api/moderation/responses/:id/reject`            | Moderator or admin      | Body`{ reason }`; the representative can read it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `GET /api/moderation/history`                          | Moderator or admin      | The moderation history log. Filters:`targetType`,`targetId`,`actorId`,`action`;`page`,`limit`(up to 100).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `GET /api/admin/users`                                 | Admin                   | Find accounts:`?q=`,`?role=`, \`?status=active                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
