### `controllers/`


| File                            | Origin                         | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `auth.controller.js`            | original, updated (tasks 1–4) | The auth handlers:`register`,`login`,`logout`,`getMe`,`forgotPassword`,`resendConfirmation`. Supabase creates and signs in accounts; Prisma reads and updates the`users`table. Errors are thrown and handled centrally. Registration returns the same 201 response for new and already-registered emails (account-enumeration protection) and builds its response from the signup result with no database read. Audit events are written fire-and-forget.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `user.controller.js`            | added (task 5)                 | Profile and notification-preference handlers for the signed-in user only:`getProfile`,`updateProfile`(a taken username returns 409`USERNAME_TAKEN`),`getNotificationPreferences`(creates the default row on first use) and`updateNotificationPreferences`. No user ID appears in any URL, so one user can never reach another's data. Audit events store field names, never values.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `hospital.controller.js`        | added (tasks 6a, 6b)           | Public hospital directory:`listHospitals`(text search, filters, sorting, pagination and near-me search),`getHospital`and`getHospitalFilters`. Search text is matched word by word against name, city, LGA and state with`%`,`_`and`\`treated literally. If that finds nothing, a typo-tolerant search runs (`src/services/hospitalSearch.js`) and the response says`search.matchType: "close"`. Near-me search lets the database discard everything outside a bounding box, then works out exact distances (haversine) for the rest. Detail pages add`contact`(with`socialMedia`for claimed hospitals),`services`and`info`, built from`hospital_data`by`src/utils/hospitalDetails.js`; the raw column is never sent. Responses follow the approved shape described in section 5 ("Hospital response shape"). The public only sees three verification states (`verified`,`claimed`,`unclaimed`); the seven internal workflow values are mapped in`PUBLIC_VERIFICATION_STATUS`, so a rejected claim or a suspension is never shown. Every hospital carries its`rating`(average and count of published reviews), and`sort=rating`ranks by a damped score so one 5-star review does not beat a well-reviewed hospital. |
| `location.controller.js`        | added (task 6a)                | `listStates`and`listLgas`: reference data for the search filters, with hospital counts, cacheable for an hour.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `review.controller.js`          | added (task 6b)                | Reviews. Public:`listHospitalReviews`and`getRatingSummary`(average, star distribution, category averages). Signed-in authors:`createReview`(one per hospital per user, email must be confirmed, held for moderation unless`REVIEWS_REQUIRE_MODERATION=false`),`updateReview`(editing the wording, ratings or department sends it back to moderation),`deleteReview`and`getMyReviews`. Anonymous reviews, and reviews of deleted accounts, show the author as "Anonymous".                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `moderation.controller.js`      | added (task 6b)                | For moderators and admins:`listReviewQueue`(oldest first),`approveReview`and`rejectReview`(a reason is required; it also takes down a published review). Each action is one atomic database step, so two moderators acting at once cannot both succeed, and nobody can moderate their own review.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `claim.controller.js`           | added (task 6c)                | For signed-in users:`createClaim`(needs a confirmed email; up to 3 claims waiting at once; the hospital becomes`claim_pending`),`withdrawClaim`,`getMyClaims`,`getMyHospitals`(the hospitals you represent, with their real status),`createVerification`(representatives of a`claimed`hospital) and`updateSocialMedia`(representatives; add, change or remove links). Every change that touches claims or status runs in one transaction that locks the hospital row first, so simultaneous actions queue up instead of deadlocking.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `claimModeration.controller.js` | added (task 6c)                | For moderators and admins: the claim queue with`approveClaim`(the claimant becomes a representative, the hospital becomes`claimed`, other waiting claims are closed) and`rejectClaim`; the verification queue with`approveVerification`and`rejectVerification`; and, for admins only,`suspendHospital`and`unsuspendHospital`. Nobody can review their own claim or request. Queues show the person's email so they can be contacted.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `document.controller.js`        | added (task 6c)                | Proof documents.`requestClaimDocumentUpload`/`requestVerificationDocumentUpload`record a file and return a one-use upload link;`confirmDocument`checks the real uploaded file (size and first bytes) and deletes it if it is not what it claimed to be;`deleteDocument`lets the owner remove a file while the submission is waiting;`getDocumentViewUrl`gives moderators a 5-minute link after writing the audit record (no record, no link).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `notification.controller.js`    | added                          | A person's own in-app notifications: list (with unread count and`?unread=true`), unread count, mark one or all as read, delete. Somebody else's notification looks like one that does not exist.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `hospitalControllers.js`        | original                       | Empty placeholder, now superseded by`hospital.controller.js`.**Delete it.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

| -------------------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `purge-documents.js` | added (task 6c) | Retention job:`npm run purge:documents`. Deletes from private storage every proof document whose retention time has passed (30 days after its claim or request was decided) and every upload nobody confirmed within 24 hours. Rows stay, marked`purged`. Safe to run twice. Run it daily from a cron job, a scheduled GitHub Action, or by hand. |

Never prints the password.                                                                                           |

Every search word must match the name, city, LGA or state; results are ranked by closeness. If the extension is missing it logs a hint and returns nothing, so exact search keeps working. All tuning values are at the top of the file. |

All text that came from a person is escaped; subjects are forced onto one line.
